meta.calibration: Rolling previous three IPL seasons; 2019–2021 public training for 2022
meta.pressure: Transparent scenario rules; sensitivity review required
meta.auction_note: No complete official 2027 auction list was verified in this review. Retained players are excluded from auction targets once confirmed; release alone does not confirm auction registration.
meta.method: Overall ability plus validated pressure adjustment; past-only venue correction

bat.name: Shimron Hetmyer
bat.reason: Best adjusted estimate among the shortlisted released batters. Conditional buy-back for finishing continuity, with a firm ceiling and overseas-slot cost.
bat.evidence: 2022–2026 adjusted estimate +7.62; 80% interval -4.54 to +17.22; 350 pressure events

bat.name: Shahrukh Khan
bat.reason: Indian finishing alternative; preserves overseas flexibility. The full-window model has wide uncertainty, so retain a firm price ceiling.
bat.evidence: 2022–2026 adjusted estimate -1.15; 80% interval -11.38 to +8.60; 167 pressure events

bat.name: Nehal Wadhera
bat.reason: Indian middle-order alternative preserving overseas places. A role-fit judgment; adjusted performance remains uncertain.
bat.evidence: 2022–2026 adjusted estimate -5.18; 80% interval -16.02 to +5.49; 215 pressure events

bat.name: Nitish Rana
bat.reason: Experienced left-handed middle-order alternative. Buy only at a discount; the model does not establish a pressure advantage.
bat.evidence: 2022–2026 adjusted estimate -4.66; 80% interval -15.85 to +7.24; 282 pressure events

bat.name: Abhishek Porel
bat.reason: Indian keeper-batter depth; a secondary need behind the established top order and Jurel.
bat.evidence: 2022–2026 adjusted estimate -2.61; 80% interval -12.48 to +7.74; 113 pressure events

bowl.name: Matheesha Pathirana
bowl.reason: Death-bowling option with a strong estimate among released candidates. Fitness and full-season availability are prerequisites.
bowl.evidence: 2022–2026 adjusted estimate +13.33; 80% interval -1.90 to +29.00; 291 pressure events

bowl.name: Trent Boult
bowl.reason: Left-arm new-ball alternative. Existing Shami and Archer coverage reduces the case for an expensive bid.
bowl.evidence: 2022–2026 adjusted estimate +6.67; 80% interval -4.72 to +17.86; 255 pressure events

bowl.name: Mitchell Starc
bowl.reason: Left-arm pace alternative with powerplay and late-innings options. Do not buy alongside every overseas fast-bowling target.
bowl.evidence: 2022–2026 adjusted estimate +11.58; 80% interval -8.24 to +31.85; 134 pressure events

bowl.name: Deepak Chahar
bowl.reason: Indian seam depth preserves overseas flexibility. Availability and fitness must justify the bid.
bowl.evidence: 2022–2026 adjusted estimate +8.08; 80% interval -8.82 to +24.59; 125 pressure events

bowl.name: Wanindu Hasaranga
bowl.reason: Positive full-window spin estimate, but RR already has Bishnoi and Jadeja. Lower-priority alternative only if role, fitness and availability justify another overseas spinner.
bowl.evidence: 2022–2026 adjusted estimate +15.13; 80% interval -0.39 to +31.65; 291 pressure events
